records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.gate_spec.ViewGate#2
records.source: THE VIEW IS PART OF THE GATE. An outline on the screen means nothing without the camera it was drawn through, so the gate carries the camera as ``projection``: a 4 x 4 matrix taking a measurement ``(x, y, z, 1)`` to homogeneous view coordinates ``(sx, sy, depth, sw)``, scaled so that ``sw`` is positive in front of the camera. The outline lives in ``(sx / sw, sy / sw)``. Rows one, two and four are the whole of what :meth:`mask` needs, so re-applying a saved gate needs no plotting library and gives the same answer on any machine; the depth row only lets the outline be drawn back into the volume from another angle.
records.context: The view is part of the data-selection boundary. An outline on the screen means nothing without the camera it was drawn through, so the data-selection boundary carries the camera as ``projection``: a 4 x 4 matrix taking a measurement ``(x, y, z, 1)`` to homogeneous view coordinates ``(sx, sy, depth, sw)``, scaled so that ``sw`` is positive in front of the camera. The outline lives in ``(sx / sw, sy / sw)``. Rows one, two and four are the whole of what :meth:`mask` needs, so re-applying a saved data-selection boundary needs no plotting library and gives the same answer on any machine; the depth row only lets the outline be drawn back into the volume from another angle.
records.translation: A VISTA FAZ PARTE DO GATE. Um contorno na tela não significa nada sem a câmera através da qual foi desenhado, então o gate carrega a câmera como ``projection``: uma matriz 4 x 4 que leva uma medição ``(x, y, z, 1)`` a coordenadas homogêneas da vista ``(sx, sy, depth, sw)``, escalada de modo que ``sw`` seja positivo à frente da câmera. O contorno vive em ``(sx / sw, sy / sw)``. As linhas um, dois e quatro são tudo de que :meth:`mask` precisa, então reaplicar um gate salvo não exige biblioteca de gráficos e dá a mesma resposta em qualquer máquina; a linha de profundidade serve só para que o contorno possa ser desenhado de volta no volume a partir de outro ângulo.

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.home.NewsPanel#2
records.source: AND THEN IT CATCHES UP. The wheel for a release cannot contain its own release note -- the note is written when the GitHub release is published, which is after that wheel is on PyPI -- so a bundled file is always one release behind the build carrying it, and that is what went wrong: "im on 1.5.1.0 and the news only goes to 1.5.0.7. the news section should always automatically reflect the latest spacr release news." Nothing here opens a socket: the panel only asks, and a fetch that fails, is rate-limited, is switched off in Preferences, or simply finds nothing newer leaves the bundled list exactly as it was drawn.

records.context: The arithmetic is "OVER", layer by layer, from the bottom. The canvas starts black. records.translation: A ARITMÉTICA É "OVER", CAMADA POR CAMADA, A PARTIR DE BAIXO. A área de desenho começa preta.
